root_cause.text: The vulnerability stems from the `cdc_ncm_rx_verify_ndp32()` function performing a bounds check on the NDP32 structure size against the total `skb` length without including the `ndpoffset`, which permits out-of-bounds reads when the NDP is located near the end of the buffer.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the condition changing from `sizeof(struct usb_cdc_ncm_ndp32) + ret * sizeof(struct usb_cdc_ncm_dpe32) > skb_in->len` to `ndpoffset + ndp_len > skb_in->len`, confirming the omission of `ndpoffset` in the original validation logic described in the CVE text.

vuln_statements.explanation: This bounds check validates that the NDP32 structure fits within the skb buffer, but critically omits ndpoffset from the calculation. When ndp32 is positioned near the end of the buffer (via ndpoffset), this check allows reading beyond the actual buffer boundary because it only compares wLength against the total skb length rather than verifying that ndpoffset + wLength <= skb_in->len. This enables out-of-bounds reads when the NDP structure is located close to the end of the received packet.
